notes.title: Content Update: Two New Levels
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/962f99d4c9d5180651cd88ce0c0aea3567718680.png

What's up, partygoers!

Today, we bring you a big content update featuring not one but TWO new levels. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/ae6fd0b0d36c0938b4975f5cfdb65dafa070f25a.gif🐸 New Level: Delirium Heights

Another free bonus level hits the scene! This level is rich with hidden environmental story details that reveal the deep lore of our beloved character, Frogger, and his homeland. Prepare for a trippy experience, uncovering secrets hidden within the game's most mysterious setting yet.

Unlocks after completing the main story.

[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/3a9d29218f1078ba802e3696aadbc3c8631a6ec7.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/354cfd2960fa470581a70a12a0175fc483d50393.gif🚀 New Level: Moon

Set foot on an unparalleled lunar adventure. Navigate through innovative traps and interact with new objects that challenge your tactical skills. Moon introduces a host of novel objectives, pushing the limits of what you thought was possible in Party Hard 2.

Unlocks after completing the main story and the Delirium Heights level.

[hr][/hr]
What Else's New:

 New objects and traps

Enhancements & Fixes:

 Default brightness and post-process options fixed.
 A bug with Marena at the Punch Club level ending fixed.

[hr][/hr]
By the way, Party Hard 2 is 80% off until April 24th! Pick it up now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/572430/Party_Hard_2/

Remember that you can gift the game to a friend and play together if you already own it.


Party harder, everybody!

notes.title: Win a free game: Workshop levels contest!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/97b93882155c504ef0cb2ead2fe987e8cbb27527.png

Hello, partygoers!

To celebrate the recent Level Editor release for Party Hard 2, we are announcing the community-made map contest: KillShop Tussle! Rules are pretty simple: 

 Make a map using the built-in Party Hard 2 Level Editor
 Upload your baby to the Steam Workshop
 Share a link here in the comment section
 Pick up a prize if you win, lick your wounds and get better if you don't

Important condition: all participating levels must be submitted to Workshop AFTER the start of this contest. Earlier works will not be accepted. One entry per person. Oh yeah, about the prize. The author of the best map will receive any Steam game or DLC made by Pinokl (us), including the new Alien Butt Form DLC and except for Party Hard 2 (we presume the winner will already have it. You’re gonna hafta own the game to make a level in the first place, right?) As for the triumphants: there will be only one, selected by the dev team. Criteria: creativity (in terms of level design), challenge, aesthetic beauty. 

KillShop Tussle ends April 9 at 5 pm UTC+3. 

Good luck everyone!

notes.title: Working Hard Devblog: Playable character teaser, story finished
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/fbb576bc8fca42b9e4a33e3e0e04ef3da5ee0842.png

What's up, community!

Welcome back to Working Hard devblog. Sorry for keeping an eerie silence for a while: it have been quite a busy and pretty vacationless summer for us so far. But we're back with the most important news we have to share with you.
----
:AnimalDJ: We have finished composing and writing the story. Dialogues are now being voiced-over by professional actors as we localize them and polish the cutscenes. In Party Hard 2's story, the masked knife-wielding protagonist seeks revenge (we hope ke knows what for) against a vicious corporation he used to work for. In the process, a shocking truth is revealed to him. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/b80982c63959e3b9d4395ff12743a6639c79ec76.gif
----
:partymask: We are excited to reveal that the sequel will have multiple playable characters just like the original Party Hard. In addition to the main character–Party Hard Killer–we have designed 3 other unique heroes for you to ruin parties as. Fans who loved sneaking about in the role of Ninja in the first game will have a surprise coming their way: a brand new stealth-based character, an extraterrestrial phenomenon Kao Tech:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/b96ae94fb7503dd96d83928739405034a1f8c911.gif
----
:partydisk: Aside from creating tons of content, we are also working hard on optimizing the game for it to run nice and easy on less powerful machines. Talk about getting ahead of performance complaints. 
------
Ok, guys, that about sums it up for now. If you have any suggestions or questions, feel free to contact us at all times. And now, let the development process continue!

Throw Party Hard 2 into your wishlists and follow it for the latest news:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/572430/Party_Hard_2/
Also, follow us and our game on Twitter and Facebook.

notes.title: Alpha 4 Trailer and Progress Report
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/GvJ7bbJ.png

Hello, Party people! Alex here with the progress report on Party Hard 2.

First off, I think we got it. We finally have the design of Party Hard 2. It was a long time coming—and previous alpha builds didn't really hit home with variety and emergent gameplay features you all loved from the original Party Hard. 

Check out the trailer for Alpha 4:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7n5h5S-5AXI

PAX Experiments
Fine folks from Pinokl have been traveling to PAX expos with us, tweaking builds alongside the feedback from alphas. This has been incremental in figuring out what works and what doesn't. The latest Alpha 4 build is a remake of the Vegas level from Party Hard. It is smaller, but has loads of procedural features. 

Featuring chickens, aliens, gas canisters you can fill up and light up with a trail, and much more—Alpha 4 demos the gameplay feel that's coming to the final game. 

There was this one specific player at PAXEast last month. At expos, many players like to stack bodies for some reason. They'd carefully kill off NPCs and stack their bodies behind dumpsters. So, this player stacks up a whole bunch of bodies behind the dumpsters. Then he takes a gas canister, fills it up, sprays it all over the bodies. And lights it on fire  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Oh, you can also party on a spaceship. 

For now we're doing pre-sales on http://PartyHard.game, so, if you want to check those alphas out, head on over.
